content.value: The diagonal of a parallelogram are given by the vectors $\underline { { A } } \doteq 3 \hat { i } - 4 \hat { j } - \hat { k }$ and. $\dot { \underline { { B } } } = 2 \hat { i } + 3 \hat { j } - 6 \hat { k }$ Prove that the parallelogram is a rhombus and determine the length of its sides.
